attempts.summary: On node1, /srv/data is now a dedicated XFS filesystem (loop-mounted from /var/lib/srv-data-fs/srvdata.img via /etc/fstab with the uquota option) owned by datauser, with an XFS user quota of 100MB soft/hard set via xfs_quota. Enforcement is filesystem-native (kernel EDQUOT, not a wrapper script) and was verified both before and after a full node reboot, confirming the mount/quota configuration persists via fstab and continues enforcing the 100MB cap post-restart.
